parameters.query:
WITH stage_counts AS (
  SELECT pipeline_id, COUNT(*) AS total_stages FROM stages GROUP BY pipeline_id
),
deal_ctx AS (
  SELECT
    o.id,
    s.display_order,
    sc.total_stages,
    c.lead_score,
    (SELECT MAX(GREATEST(a.completed_at, a.created_at)) FROM activities a WHERE a.opportunity_id = o.id) AS last_activity_at,
    (SELECT p.status FROM proposals p WHERE p.opportunity_id = o.id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS proposal_status,
    (SELECT p.viewed_at FROM proposals p WHERE p.opportunity_id = o.id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS proposal_viewed_at,
    (SELECT p.emailed_at FROM proposals p WHERE p.opportunity_id = o.id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS proposal_emailed_at,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contracts ct WHERE ct.opportunity_id = o.id AND ct.status = 'signed') AS contract_signed,
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM payments pay JOIN invoices i ON i.id = pay.invoice_id
      WHERE i.opportunity_id = o.id AND i.invoice_type = 'down_payment' AND pay.status = 'paid'
    ) AS down_payment_paid,
    o.expected_close
  FROM opportunities o
  JOIN stages s ON s.id = o.stage_id
  JOIN stage_counts sc ON sc.pipeline_id = o.pipeline_id
  LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.id = o.contact_id
  WHERE o.status = 'Open' AND o.is_archived = false
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    LEAST(100, GREATEST(0,
      ROUND(((display_order + 1)::numeric / NULLIF(total_stages, 0)) * 40) +
      LEAST(20, ROUND(COALESCE(lead_score, 0) * 0.2)) +
      (CASE proposal_status WHEN 'approved' THEN 25 WHEN 'viewed' THEN 15 WHEN 'emailed' THEN 5 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN contract_signed THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN down_payment_paid THEN 15 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE
        WHEN last_activity_at IS NULL THEN -25
        WHEN last_activity_at < now() - interval '30 days' THEN -25
        WHEN last_activity_at < now() - interval '14 days' THEN -15
        WHEN last_activity_at >= now() - interval '7 days' THEN 10
        ELSE 0
      END) +
      (CASE WHEN expected_close IS NOT NULL AND expected_close < CURRENT_DATE THEN -15 ELSE 0 END)
    )) AS win_score,
    CASE
      WHEN contract_signed AND NOT down_payment_paid THEN 'Contract signed — send the down payment invoice'
      WHEN down_payment_paid THEN 'Down payment received — schedule the job and prep the final invoice'
      WHEN proposal_status = 'approved' THEN 'Proposal approved — send the contract'
      WHEN proposal_status = 'viewed' THEN
        'Proposal viewed ' || GREATEST(0, EXTRACT(DAY FROM now() - proposal_viewed_at)::int) || 'd ago, not approved — follow up now'
      WHEN proposal_status = 'emailed' AND proposal_emailed_at < now() - interval '3 days' THEN
        'Proposal sent ' || GREATEST(0, EXTRACT(DAY FROM now() - proposal_emailed_at)::int) || 'd ago, not opened — check in or resend'
      WHEN proposal_status = 'emailed' THEN 'Proposal sent — awaiting response'
      WHEN proposal_status IS NULL THEN 'No proposal sent yet — send one to move this forward'
      WHEN last_activity_at IS NULL OR last_activity_at < now() - interval '21 days' THEN 'Stalling — no recent activity, reach out'
      ELSE 'On track — recently active'
    END AS win_score_reason
  FROM deal_ctx
)
UPDATE opportunities
SET win_score = scored.win_score, win_score_reason = scored.win_score_reason
FROM scored
WHERE opportunities.id = scored.id
  AND (opportunities.win_score IS DISTINCT FROM scored.win_score OR opportunities.win_score_reason IS DISTINCT FROM scored.win_score_reason)
RETURNING opportunities.id, opportunities.win_score;
